steps.title: Submit a collision claim
steps.say: First notice of loss: a policyholder reports a collision, names a repair shop, and uploads six photos and a police report. Contact details are hashed on the way in.

body.police_report_text:
METRO POLICE DEPARTMENT - TRAFFIC COLLISION REPORT
Report No: PR-2026-048812
Date of incident: {{loss_date}}
Location: Alder Ave at 4th St
Vehicles involved: 2
Injuries reported: no
Witnesses: none
Narrative: Vehicle 1 states it was struck on the front left while turning. Vehicle 2 left before officers arrived.

steps.title: Find the damage
steps.say: A job runs the pipeline. The vision model marks damaged pixels and names the part they are on; each finding carries a severity and a confidence.

steps.title: Price the repair
steps.say: Findings are merged per part and joined to a parts and labour catalogue for this vehicle class and region. The range reflects how sure the model is and whether a borderline part is repaired or replaced.

steps.title: Look at who is connected
steps.say: The claimant filed under an initial, but the phone and address match an existing person. That person, the people who share their details, and the repair shop have history.

steps.title: Route the claim
steps.say: The fraud score is above the referral threshold, so the claim goes to special investigations, with the reasons that moved the score.

steps.title: An adjuster overrides a finding
steps.say: One low-confidence finding is not damage. The adjuster rejects it with a reason; the estimate is recalculated and the correction is kept as a training label.

body.reason: Reflection on the panel, not damage. Checked against the other photos.
